post.description: Public Gateway endpoint. Uses authenticated internal gRPC; no browser service token, Bearer token or cookie is required. JSON body is limited to 4096 bytes. Pending, unknown, active, deleted and account-quota-limited emails have the same 202 body. Auth permits one verification intent per minute and at most 20 per rolling day, including signup. Edge quota can return 429 independently. ACCEPTED is not proof of delivery. No automatic retry or Idempotency-Key replay is supported. Timeout can occur after the downstream request was accepted.

post.description: A successful form returns a nonce-CSP HTML page that submits only code and state to the same-origin completion endpoint, with a manual Continue button if JavaScript is disabled. 200 does not mean authenticated. The original SameSite=Lax state cookie may be absent on this cross-site POST. The page neither sets nor clears cookies. Provider cancellation/error, code+error, unsupported providers, malformed/ambiguous/oversized forms and unsupported media types return a generic JSON 400 without downstream Auth calls. Optional id_token/user are ignored. All responses use no-store, no-referrer and nosniff; HTML also forbids framing and external resources. Do not log or persist code/state/form bodies or put them in URLs.

post.description: Submitted by the Gateway-origin intermediate page. Requires exactly one original oauth_state_apple cookie equal to the form state; missing, mismatched, other-provider or duplicate cookies return 400 before Auth. Auth atomically consumes provider/state before exchanging the code and rejects expired, consumed or racing state. Success sets the refresh HttpOnly cookie and clears the Apple state cookie; refreshToken in JSON is empty. Responses use no-store/no-referrer/nosniff. A timeout may follow state consumption or session creation: never automatically resubmit, infer rollback or generate replacement state to retry this callback. GET callbacks remain available unchanged.

BearerAuth.description: RS256 access token issued by auth-service. Enter only the token; Swagger UI adds the Bearer prefix.

RefreshCookie.name: refresh_token
RefreshCookie.description: HttpOnly refresh-token cookie with the invariant public name refresh_token. Swagger UI cannot read the value but sends the browser cookie when withCredentials is enabled.

OAuthStateCookie.name: oauth_state_{provider}
OAuthStateCookie.description: One-time HttpOnly OAuth state cookie bound to the provider path parameter. The provider-to-cookie mapping is declared by x-provider-cookie-names.

XCorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
XCorrelationId.description: Optional end-to-end correlation identifier. If omitted, the Gateway generates one and always echoes it in the response.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Optional client request identifier used by mutation audit, deletion, and recommendation workflows. X-Correlation-Id is used as a fallback where supported.

XClientId.name: X-Client-Id
XClientId.description: Optional registered Gateway client-profile identifier recorded in bounded telemetry.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional key for the explicitly supported owner mutation routes. Reuse only for the identical authenticated command; keys are limited to 1–128 ASCII graphic characters and replay lasts 24 hours.

XCorrelationId.description: Correlation identifier generated or accepted by the Gateway.

SetCookie.description: One or more Set-Cookie values. Authentication cookies are HttpOnly; OAuth operations may also set or clear a state cookie.

Location.description: Operation-status resource or OAuth provider redirect URI.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before polling a queued operation or retrying after service saturation.

OperationId.description: Gateway-assigned identifier for the durable mutation intent.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: Present with value true when the response reuses an existing operation or durable owner receipt.

refreshToken.description: Always an empty string at the public REST edge. The actual refresh token is sent only as an HttpOnly cookie.

state.description: One-time state matching the OAuth state cookie.

Scenery.description: Optional v1 illustrated skin. Loader enforces aggregate transfer/pixel budgets, unique IDs/paths, frame/world bounds and exact map-sized ground; original map geometry stays authoritative. depth_y=-1 is a ground-attached detail.
